examples.arabic: ديمة وعلي، طالبان جامعيان، عم يشاهدوا نشرة الأخبار السياسية بلهفة على شاشة الكلية الكبيرة.
examples.english: Dima and Ali, two university students, were eagerly watching the political news broadcast on the large college screen.
examples.transliteration: Dima w Ali, taliban jami'iyyan, 'am yshaahdu nashret el-akhbar el-siyasiya bi-lehfeh 'ala shashet el-kulliyeh el-kbireh.
examples.storyTitle: Echoes of News at the University

examples.arabic: ليلى شافت موبايلها مرة تانية، بس الشاشة كانت سودا؛ هي ضاعت بحمرا أكيد، واجتماع التبرعات قرب.
examples.english: Layla checked her phone again, but the screen was black; she was definitely lost in Hamra, and the donations meeting was soon.
examples.transliteration: Layla shafet mobaylha marra tanya, bas el shasha kanet sawda; hiya da'et bi Hamra akeed, w'ejtima' el tabarru'at 'arrab.
examples.storyTitle: Layla in Hamra: The Donation Journey

examples.arabic: يا بني زمان كنا نلعب بالطابة برا مو نتفرج على شاشة صغيرة
examples.english: My son in the old days we used to play with the ball outside not watch on a small screen
examples.transliteration: Ya buni zamān kunna nilʿab biṭ-ṭāba barra mū nitfarraj ʿala shāsha ṣaghīra
